turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of class. Who decided on the zero?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Open mind. I asked you who decided, and when.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
The day isn't over. Who entered the zero, Hale, and what's it based on?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Show me what you have, or I'm walking down the hall.
